purpose: Editable seasonal outdoor water-use rules used by local landing pages, booking/service-area guidance, dispatch review, and local SEO content.
fallback_behavior: The database is preferred when configured. The non-build-specific JSON file is the deploy-safe fallback. JavaScript files must not contain mutable municipal rule text.
review_policy: Verify official municipal/county sources before each seasonal period and whenever a temporary restriction or emergency notice is posted.

rules.rule_summary: Oxford County outdoor water-use reminder: May 1 to September 30, outdoor water use by hose or attachment, including vehicle washing and power washing, follows address parity. Even-numbered addresses use even-numbered days; odd-numbered addresses use odd-numbered days. Residential windows are 6:00–9:00 a.m. or 6:00–9:00 p.m.; commercial/industrial windows are 8:00–10:00 a.m. or 3:00–5:00 p.m. Confirm current municipal/county notices before exterior work.
rules.address_rule: Even-numbered addresses on even-numbered days; odd-numbered addresses on odd-numbered days.
rules.applies_to: Outdoor water use by hose or attachment, including vehicle washing and power washing.
rules.label: Oxford County seasonal outdoor water-use rule

rules.rule_summary: Norfolk County outdoor water-use reminder: May 15 to September 15, outdoor water use is allowed only 9:00–11:00 a.m. and 7:00–10:00 p.m.; odd-numbered houses use odd calendar days and even-numbered houses use even calendar days. Confirm current County notices before exterior work.
rules.address_rule: Odd-numbered houses on odd calendar days; even-numbered houses on even calendar days.
rules.applies_to: Outdoor water use under Norfolk County's seasonal watering restriction by-law.
rules.label: Norfolk County seasonal outdoor water-use rule
